items.text:
Concept is great, some aspect of the game are tedius and boring ( interacting with any NPC for example ).

Encountered a few bug, the latest one is no longer being able to install floors. That's not ideal as you can image.

Might eventually be good, but right now it needs some more love

items.text:
Sadly not the game I was hopping for:

It's just a bunch of unrelated features thrown into a mix with a bad 2D space engineer rip-off.
Systems such as NPC interactions are completely meaningless and boring. 
The game is not challenging at all.

And you'll never be sure whether it's a bug or just not programmed into the game.
On one occasion, I had two NPCs die at the K-Log port in front of a kiosk. None of the other NPCs reacted to it, and the bodies were still there hours later.

Another example of this abysmal game design:
I boarded a neutral ship above K-Log, and the game indicated that this was a hostile act with consequences. However, neither the pilot nor anyone on K-Log recognised this. 

Even after killing the pilot and selling some of his ship parts at the port, nothing happened.

It feels like different mechanics have been thrown together without any real purpose.
items.text_zh:
遗憾的是，这不是我所期待的游戏：

它只是一堆互不相关的功能混杂在一起，再加上一个糟糕的2D版《太空工程师》山寨货。
像NPC互动这样的系统完全毫无意义且无聊。
这游戏根本没有任何挑战性。

而且你永远无法确定某个东西是bug还是根本没被编程进游戏里。
有一次，我在K-Log港的一个售货亭前有两个NPC死了。其他NPC都没有对此做出反应，几个小时后尸体还在那里。

另一个这种糟糕游戏设计的例子：
我在K-Log上方登上了一艘中立飞船，游戏提示这是一种敌对行为并会有后果。然而，无论是飞行员还是K-Log上的任何人都没有意识到这一点。

即使在杀死飞行员并在港口卖掉他的一些飞船部件之后，什么也没有发生。

感觉就像不同的机制被胡乱拼凑在一起，没有任何真正的目的。

observations.description: NPC互动系统毫无意义且无聊
observations.evidence: Systems such as NPC interactions are completely meaningless and boring.
observations.evidence_zh: 诸如NPC互动之类的系统完全毫无意义且无聊。

items.text: It's really good, but not perfect. I think there could be much better 3D modeling for characters and held props and the life simulation/conversations with NPCs is very rough around the edges for this being 1.0. More often then not they'll just wander away mid conversation or simply fail to give a reply, stalling the convo until it fixes itself.  The prebaked responses get old fast, I genuinely feel like I'm just talking to the same person over and over again, no one so far really striking me as unique or memorable. Also the sprites used are pretty hard to identify visually at first, couldn't really tell what most things were at first glance without right clicking it or holding alt. All that being said, I really enjoy the concept and have had some fun so far. Just feel like it's missing a lot more depth/refinement/polish to truly immerse me in the world and characters. Hopefully this 1.0 achievement will fund the project a little further so these things can be overhauled. There's something truly great here, it just needs more time to fully get there imo.
items.text_zh: 它真的很好，但并不完美。我认为角色和手持道具的3D建模本可以好得多，而且对于1.0版本来说，与NPC的生活模拟/对话非常粗糙。很多时候他们会在对话中途直接走开，或者干脆不回复，让对话卡住，直到它自己恢复正常。预设好的回应很快就让人腻了，我真的感觉自己只是在一遍又一遍地和同一个人说话，到目前为止没有人真正让我觉得独特或难忘。另外，使用的精灵图一开始在视觉上很难辨认，第一眼不右键点击或按住Alt的话，我根本看不出大多数东西是什么。话虽如此，我真的很喜欢这个概念，到目前为止也玩得挺开心。只是觉得它缺少更多深度/打磨/润色，无法真正让我沉浸到这个世界和角色中。希望这个1.0成就能为项目再提供一些资金，让这些东西得以重做。这里确实有非常棒的东西，只是在我看来还需要更多时间才能完全达到那个水准。
